description: Runs awaitables concurrently and returns their results in argument order. The first error propagates; the other tasks keep running.
Makes `gather` return exceptions as items of the result list instead of raising, so partial results survive a failure.
Waits on a set of tasks and returns `(done, pending)` without raising or cancelling anything; `return_when` picks the condition.
Requests cancellation: `CancelledError` is raised inside the task at its next `await`, so cleanup still runs.
The event loop keeps only weak references to tasks; keep a strong one (a variable, a set, a group) until the task is done.
